svg.title: 4D MAE / B5: policy and trajectory completion
svg.desc: PullCube configuration. RGB, state, and observed point history condition a shared HPT. The action and trajectory heads receive separate context slices. The trajectory tokenizer is shared across observation encoding and decoder inputs. Only the action branch is used for control.
svg.text: Control uses the action branch. Trajectory completion supplies auxiliary training supervision.
One decoder, called separately for C and Q.
64 C points · 64 Q points · 16 history frames · privileged simulator history in PullCube
